For U2, implement HDFS commit acknowledgments using HDFS's native commit mechanisms and integrate with stream pipeline code.
For U3, override partition functions by extending module configuration classes to allow custom partition logic.
For U4, design a consumer that can handle multiple topic-partitions by aggregating data into a single queue.
For U5, develop a new DSL parser that maintains context across multiple stream definitions to avoid parsing errors.
For U6, design a single-container deployment architecture using colocated modules with shared memory or messaging.
For U7, standardize handling of ConfigurableConversionService tuples by implementing a uniform deserialization hook.
For U8, use JMH (Java Microbenchmark Harness) for benchmarking and compare metrics with JMX enabled/disabled.
assumptions: The existing codebase is modular and allows for isolated changes to BaseDefinition and stream pipeline components.
Necessary dependencies (e.g., HDFS libraries, JMH) are already available or can be integrated without major conflicts.
Testing environments for HDFS, Kafka, and JMX are pre-configured and accessible.
Documentation will be written in parallel with development tasks.
All user stories are independent unless explicitly stated otherwise.

activities.activity_description: Remove the list of modules from BaseDefinition and adjust related code to reparse as needed.
Develop logic to reparse modules dynamically after removal from BaseDefinition.
Write and execute unit tests for refactored BaseDefinition and reparse logic.
Validate integration with existing stream deployment workflows.
Update documentation to reflect changes in BaseDefinition and reparse behavior.
Add logic to track and acknowledge actual HDFS commits in stream pipelines.
Integrate HDFS commit acknowledgments into existing stream pipeline components.
Test HDFS write reliability and acknowledgment mechanisms.
Document HDFS commit acknowledgment workflow and configuration.
Allow source/processor modules to override default partition functions for custom routing.
Verify partition override functionality with sample data.
Explain how to configure and use partition function overrides.
Implement consumer logic to read from multiple Kafka topic-partitions and aggregate into a single queue.
Test multi-topic-partition consumption and data aggregation.
Document configuration and usage of multi-topic-partition consumers.
Create a parser that maintains context across multiple stream definitions for Flo UI.
Ensure the parser correctly interprets interdependent stream definitions.
Validate parser behavior with complex multi-stream examples.
Document the new DSL parser and its usage in Flo UI.
Design architecture for colocating all modules within a stream in a single container.
Develop code to deploy and manage colocated modules in a single container.
Test single-container deployment with sample streams.
Document the single-container deployment approach and configuration.
Standardize handling of non-default conversion service tuples to prevent resets after deserialization.
Verify that conversion service tuples are preserved during deserialization.
Document the uniform handling approach for conversion service tuples.
Configure benchmarking environment with and without JMX enabled.
Execute performance tests to measure differences with JMX enabled/disabled.
Analyze and document performance metrics and trade-offs of JMX usage.
